title: I got no power No water No kids No wife No light Just whiskey And strings Mixing tonic In a key of G. #SMALLPOEMS
summary: I got no power No water No kids No wife No light Just whiskey And strings Mixing tonic In a key of G. #SMALLPOEMS

body_html:
I got no power
No water
No kids

No wife
No light

Just whiskey
And strings
Mixing tonic
In a key of
G.
#SMALLPOEMS
